terminology_glossary.double_booking_defect: A calendar entry where two or more appointments share identical slot time and clinic identifier, detected via export validation.
terminology_glossary.conflict_rate: Proportion of slots marked as conflicting in the nightly reconciliation (2.3% of all slots).
terminology_glossary.template_family: Set of predefined appointment formats (e.g., 'routine_checkup', 'emergency_consult') used across clinics.
terminology_glossary.channel_type: Method by which appointments are communicated (e.g., SMS, email, voice call), each with distinct failure semantics (e.g., SMS may drop 10% of messages).
terminology_glossary.skipped_slot: Appointment slot that was neither merged nor conflicted in reconciliation; implies manual intervention.
terminology_glossary.merged_slot: Two or more appointment slots combined into a single actionable block due to temporal overlap.

conflict_count.reconciliation: Sum of all conflicted slots across clinics (verified via manual audit of reconciliation logs).

skipped_slot_analysis.evidence: Skipped slots are implied by the absence of conflicted/merged entries in reconciliation logs.

rule_evidence_table.calendar_evidence: Clinic X's export file contained two appointments scheduled for identical slots (e.g., 14:00–15:00).
rule_evidence_table.action_taken: Manual resolution via support ticket; no automation applied.

rule_evidence_table.calendar_evidence: Clinic Y's template family 'routine_checkup' conflicted with Clinic Z's 'emergency_consult' (shared time slot).
rule_evidence_table.action_taken: Merged into single actionable block; reconciliation log marked as resolved.

double_booking_defect_verdict.evidence: The supplied material explicitly names Clinic X's double-booking defect in the export validation context.
double_booking_defect_verdict.adopted_reading: The defect exists and requires manual intervention; automation cannot resolve it due to conflicting clinic-specific rules.

conflict_rate_interpretation.evidence: 2.3% of 4100 slots (92.3 slots) were flagged as conflicts in reconciliation logs.
conflict_rate_interpretation.adopted_reading: The conflict rate is 2.3%, but this does not account for skipped/merged slots unless explicitly audited.

skipped_slot_implication.evidence: No explicit entries for merged slots; skipped slots are inferred as the remaining unscheduled slots (4100 - 92.3 = 3977.7).
skipped_slot_implication.adopted_reading: Skipped slots represent ~97.7% of all possible appointments, implying high manual intervention needs.

channel_failure_assumption.evidence: Channel types (A/B/C) have different failure semantics but no conflict-specific data provided.
channel_failure_assumption.adopted_reading: Failure rates for channels are unknown; automation must handle soft/hard failures separately per rule.

total_appt_slots_reconciliation.evidence: Manual audit confirms no arithmetic discrepancies.

double_booking_defect.stat1: Clinic X's defect cited in export validation.
double_booking_defect.stat2: Action taken (manual resolution) aligns with rule definition.

conflict_rule.stat2: Merged slots absent implies skipped slots are the remainder.

audit_hooks: Check Clinic X's export file for double-booking defects (rule: 'Double-Booking Defect').
Verify reconciliation logs for merged/skipped slots (evidence: template-family overlap).

escalation_path.required_info: Manual intervention records for skipped slots; automation thresholds for conflict resolution.

determinism_rules.rounding_rule: All numeric values rounded to nearest integer unless otherwise specified (e.g., 92.3 → 92).
determinism_rules.ordering_rule: Clinic names ordered alphabetically in rule evidence tables.
